pages.raw_title: About Oxford | House of Lifestyle Brands
pages.raw_meta: Oxford is a house of premium American lifestyle brands, stewarding distinctive companies with shared support and creative autonomy for long-term growth.
raw_blocks: Company / Who We Are
We are the parent company behind the most beloved lifestyle brands in the U.S.
Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, Oxford is not just an owner. We’re stewards, growing great businesses, while staying true to what makes them special.
An 80-year legacy of reinvention.

Growing from a WWII-era manufacturer into a leading brand steward, we have consistently evolved alongside the world, investing through headwinds, anticipating consumer shifts, and embracing change as a growth strategy.
Founded as a manufacturer of private label apparel
Becomes a public company and has paid a dividend every quarter since
Acquires Tommy Bahama, launching transformation away from manufacturing into managing lifestyle brands
Expands further into womenswear, menswear, and childrenswear with Lilly Pulitzer, Southern Tide, Duck Head, and The Beaufort Bonnet Company
Diversifies across geographies, categories, seasons and price points with the acquisitions of Johnny Was and Jack Rogers
Invests in retail expansion and scalable infrastructure with state-of-the-art distribution center

Everyone at Oxford sees themselves as part of a family that learns from each other, rises together, and works toward collective success. We fill our teams with those deeply connected to our mission and committed to growth at all levels.
Meet Our Team Join Our Team

Our house of brands is defined by emotional resonance and uncommon staying power in the affordable luxury category. We seek out businesses within U.S. regions that create irreplicable experiences people return to through every new season in life and style.

pages.raw_title: Our Brands | Premium American Lifestyle | Oxford
pages.raw_meta: Discover Oxford’s house of premium lifestyle brands built on stewardship, creativity, and emotionally resonant experiences that endure over time.
raw_blocks: The lifestyle brands we own are iconic American powerhouses because they’re loved. They allow for true expression and evoke unquestionable joy, making them unforgettable, resilient, and profitable across any span of time.
Long Live the Island Life
Tommy Bahama was once just a clothing brand. Today, it's a premium lifestyle destination, blending resortwear with retail and vibrant hospitality including a fully immersive hotel experience.
Visit Tommy Bahama Opens in a new tab
Created by founders who imagined a life of perpetual island living, Tommy Bahama was born from a dream of never leaving the beach—a vision that continues to inspire its relaxed, coastal lifestyle.

Tommy Bahama is our largest brand, representing over half our business. Its powerful reach and consumer awareness are fueled by its universal appeal—effortlessly evoking the feeling of a tropical getaway.
Lilly Pulitzer is a colorful explosion of hand-painted prints and resort clothing, inspiring confidence and optimism for all women to shine bright and stand out.
Visit Lilly Pulitzer Opens in a new tab
It all started with one incredible woman who had the courage to find her joy and create her own sunshine.
Beloved for its iconic prints and lasting silhouettes, Lilly Pulitzer inspires loyalty and emotional resonance—and leads as our most profitable brand.
Johnny Was designs women’s clothing that unites vintage and boho chic with California dreaming, igniting free-spirited optimism through beauty, artistic expression and timeless appeal.
Visit Johnny Was Opens in a new tab

Johnny Was pieces are known for their captivating details that inspire a sense of wanderlust. Each collection reflects the brand’s signature California spirit, first embodied in its original Santa Monica store.
Defined by exceptional craftsmanship and curated exclusivity, each Johnny Was piece is both rare and collectible—designed to keep customers coming back again and again.
Sharing the spirit of coastal living
Rooted in coastal hues, Southern Tide blends relaxed refinement with put-together performance, designed to take you seamlessly from dawn to dusk.
Visit Southern Tide Opens in a new tab
Southern Tide’s “Skipjack” logo was one of the most successful apparel icons in southeastern college towns.

Southern Tide fueled its growth through one of the earliest, most successful brand ambassador campaigns and positioning that transcends its regional origins, creating substantial potential for expansion.
The Beaufort Bonnet Company is a children’s lifestyle brand devoted to celebrating the joy of childhood and inspiring families to treasure the moments that matter most.
Visit The Beaufort Bonnet Company Opens in a new tab
The signature bonnet that launched the brand traces back to a generations-old heirloom pattern from Beaufort, SC.
Beaufort Bonnet inspires a world where childhood remains sweet, simple & wrapped in tradition, creating quality pieces that families cherish for every moment of their little ones’ lives.
Made to be Worn Since 1865
Duck Head remains true to its roots by producing garments of enduring quality and timeless style for the Social Sportsman.
Visit Duck Head Opens in a new tab
In 1865, Duck Head founders, George and Joe O’Bryan created their first work pants from surplus duck cloth army tents.
With deep roots and a legacy of iconic campaigns, Duck Head is one of America’s oldest and most recognizable brands—presenting a powerful opportunity to engage a new generation.
Every Step of a Well Loved Life
Jack Rogers is defined by its signature whipstitched sandals and easy elegance—resort clothing for the refined modern woman.
Visit Jack Rogers Opens in a new tab

In the 1960s, a chic American traveler brought home a handcrafted Italian sandal with whipstitched leather, inspiring the creation of the original Jack Rogers style—an enduring icon of timeless elegance.
Jack Rogers brings heritage and diversification to the portfolio, combining recognizability with real staying power.
